Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps — Redwood MAP draft

Hi Jessica / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the call today — useful to align on the procurement path. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so we can agree owners, dependencies, and a target close date. High level milestones in the MAP: 

- Procurement platform setup (Ariba / Coupa) — note you mentioned Coupa; I left both as options in the draft.
- Vendor forms (procurement questionnaire / supplier form)
- W-9 collection and banking details for AP/payment setup
- PO issuance / SOW approval (legal/finance sign-off)

Proposed responsibilities and target dates (see attached MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx):
- Acme (procurement): provide Coupa supplier onboarding link and complete vendor form — target: 2026-09-15
- Redwood (sales/ops): submit vendor packet (W-9, banking instructions), complete Redwood supplier registration — target: 2026-09-22
- Legal/Finance (both sides): contract redlines + PO — target: 2026-09-29

Dependencies called out in the MAP: internal Acme supplier approvals, finance vendor verification, and legal turnaround on standard T&Cs. Suggested target close for go-live (payments + vendor in Coupa): 2026-10-01 — flexible if ACME needs additional lead time.

Could you confirm: 1) Coupa is the correct path and provide the supplier onboarding link, 2) who will complete the ACME vendor form (name & email), and 3) whether AP requires any special banking form in addition to the W-9? Once I have that I will update the MAP and assign action owners.

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jessica Li <jessica.li@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps — Redwood MAP draft

Camila — thanks for the summary and MAP. Couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

- We use Coupa (not Ariba) for supplier onboarding. Our vendor onboarding portal link is: https://app.coupa.com/supplier/onboarding/ACME-12345 (I pasted the self-service link in case your ops team wants it).
- I attached the Acme vendor form (ACME_Vendor_Form.pdf) — please complete and return with your W-9.
- AP requires a completed W-9 and a voided check or ACH authorization form for banking setup. They typically take 2-3 business days to validate once they have the documents, but procurement approvals and supplier number issuance can take up to 2 weeks depending on volume.
- Our standard payment terms are Net30. If you need expedited onboarding, let me know and I can request priority processing but we'll need to justify it to finance.

Proposed timeline from our side: vendor form + W-9 returned by 2026-09-10, Coupa supplier creation by 2026-09-24, full enablement (PO + payment terms) by ~2026-10-01. That aligns with your proposed go-live.

Next steps for me: I will route the completed vendor form to our AP team and share the supplier number when it's available.

Thanks,
Jessica Li
Senior Procurement Specialist | Acme Payments
jessica.li@acme.com

Attachments: ACME_Vendor_Form.pdf
